FREEDOS_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install freedos. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

FREEDOS_VERSION.description: Specific version of freedos to install.

FREEDOS_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading freedos binary or archive artifacts.

FREEDOS_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying freedos available remote releases.

FREEDOS_BUILD_MODE.description: Kernel synthesis mode: from-source (OpenWatcom + NASM) or repack (official FreeDOS kernel archive).

FREEDOS_CPU_TARGET.description: Target x86 CPU generation for KERNEL.SYS (86, 186, or 386).

FREEDOS_FAT_SUPPORT.description: Maximum FAT filesystem width compiled into KERNEL.SYS (fat16 or fat32).

FREEDOS_SERIAL_CONSOLE.description: Enable COM1 serial console telemetry support during boot staging when set to 1.
